Le versant agricole et industriel de Leo: Leonida’s farming and industrial side, built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery.
Ambrosia est le cœur rural et industriel: Ambrosia is the state’s rural and industrial heart: sugarcane fields, silos, straight roads and the smokestacks of the Allied Crystal refinery towering over the landscape.
Rockstar résume la région d’une phrase :: Rockstar sums up the region in one line: the refinery provides the jobs, the local biker gang provides everything else.
Les captures officielles y montrent des: Official screenshots there show motorcycle convoys on country roads, biker gatherings, a female biker waving a Mustang .357 revolver and mud parties.
C’est une Amérique de vieilles valeurs e: It’s an America of old values and old engines, far from the towers of Vice City, that Jason and Lucia pass through over the course of the story.
